reason: The chain itself is right and real 65SC12 code: CMP #&95/BCS (5 cycles on the >=&95 path, against 9), AND #&FD/CMP #&85/BEQ isolates &85/&87 within &80-&94, white path 10 against 12, &85 path 11 against 5; 10 bytes against 12, branches in range, no self-modified operand in it (pix_operand etc. are written by label). But the 2 bytes saved move all of bank 4 after &9AAA by -2 (render.6502's rest, sprite_columns, compiled_table, sprite_straight up to REN_BASE: no ALIGN in between), and the candidate admits it did not recount the page crossings. Recounted from build/strykers.lst: BPL each_part at &9DFF (target &9DCB) stops crossing a page (-1 a taken iteration), but BNE out at &9FFE in record_differs (next &A000, target &A02E) starts crossing: the next instruction would be at &9FFE, page &9F, target &A02C, page &A0, so +1 every time a mover's record differs (it runs per mover per pass, and taken whenever a mover moved or changed frame, the common case). Indexed tables in the moved range also shift (sprite_column_count &A366, sky_blk_lo/hi &A356/&A35E, straight_sprite_lo/hi &A498/&A4E4) and the sprites read by (zp),Y from sprite_straight change their page crossings with their alignment. The net of these against the claimed 2.9 cycles a pass is not established and could well be negative (the record_differs BNE alone can cost more than 2.9 a pass); unproven, so refuted. A same-size variant (or one padded back to 12 bytes) would avoid this.
